#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -Eeuo pipefail

STAMP="$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)"
TA="$(mktemp /tmp/andrik-agent-r1026.XXXXXX.mjs)"
TC="$(mktemp /tmp/andrik-clean-r1026.XXXXXX.py)"
trap 'rm -f "$TA" "$TC"' EXIT

AGENT_SHA256="e8a5b91549b42df93083ed0a46886a2a5f7a28f3b818b96a1d9c699762b3988d"
CLEAN_SHA256="81f82b01e4265969e980ef53b3e7864c69a8c5871502bb1f7135e581355bd6fc"

read -r -d '' AGENT_B64 <<'PAYLOAD_AGENT' || true

PAYLOAD_AGENT

read -r -d '' CLEAN_B64 <<'PAYLOAD_CLEAN' || true

PAYLOAD_CLEAN

echo "=========================================================="
echo " ANDRIK R1026 · OFFLINE VPS INSTALL · NO CURL / NO CLOUDFLARE"
echo " RADIO SERVICE WILL NOT BE RESTARTED"
echo "=========================================================="


# Decode embedded payloads without network access.
printf '%s' "$AGENT_B64" | base64 -d | python3 -c 'import sys,zlib; sys.stdout.buffer.write(zlib.decompress(sys.stdin.buffer.read()))' > "$TA"
printf '%s' "$CLEAN_B64" | base64 -d | python3 -c 'import sys,zlib; sys.stdout.buffer.write(zlib.decompress(sys.stdin.buffer.read()))' > "$TC"

echo
echo "=== VERIFY EMBEDDED FILES ==="
echo "$AGENT_SHA256  $TA" | sha256sum -c -
echo "$CLEAN_SHA256  $TC" | sha256sum -c -
node --check "$TA"
python3 -m py_compile "$TC"
grep -Fq "AGENT_VERSION_R803='R1026'" "$TA"
grep -Fq "cleanup-r1026" "$TA"
grep -Fq "active-radio-cgroup-not-confirmed" "$TC"
grep -Fq "ppid'] != 1" "$TC"
echo "✅ embedded R1026 payload verified"

install_one() {
  local src="$1" dst="$2" mode="$3"
  if [ -f "$dst" ]; then
    cp -a "$dst" "$dst.before-R1026-$STAMP"
  fi
  install -m "$mode" "$src" "$dst"
}

echo
echo "=== INSTALL WEB AGENT + SAFE CLEANUP ==="
install_one "$TA" /usr/local/lib/andrik-radio-web-agent-r803.mjs 0755
install_one "$TC" /usr/local/sbin/andrik-radio-safe-cleanup-r1026 0755

for old in   /usr/local/lib/andrik-radio-web-agent-r721.mjs   /usr/local/lib/andrik-radio-web-agent-r802.mjs
do
  if [ -f "$old" ]; then
    install_one "$TA" "$old" 0755
  fi
done

unit_exists() {
  systemctl list-unit-files --type=service --no-legend 2>/dev/null     | awk '{print $1}'     | grep -Fxq "$1"
}
unit_active() {
  systemctl is-active --quiet "$1" 2>/dev/null
}

CANON=""
if unit_exists andrik-radio-web.service && unit_active andrik-radio-web.service; then
  CANON="andrik-radio-web.service"
elif unit_exists andrik-radio-web-agent.service && unit_active andrik-radio-web-agent.service; then
  CANON="andrik-radio-web-agent.service"
elif unit_exists andrik-radio-web.service; then
  CANON="andrik-radio-web.service"
elif unit_exists andrik-radio-web-agent.service; then
  CANON="andrik-radio-web-agent.service"
else
  echo "❌ web-agent service not found"
  exit 40
fi

RADIO_BEFORE="$(systemctl show -p MainPID --value andrik-radio.service 2>/dev/null || true)"
RADIO_STATE_BEFORE="$(systemctl is-active andrik-radio.service 2>/dev/null || true)"

echo
echo "=== RESTART WEB AGENT ONLY ==="
systemctl restart "$CANON"
sleep 3

RADIO_AFTER="$(systemctl show -p MainPID --value andrik-radio.service 2>/dev/null || true)"
RADIO_STATE_AFTER="$(systemctl is-active andrik-radio.service 2>/dev/null || true)"
WEB_STATE="$(systemctl is-active "$CANON" 2>/dev/null || true)"

echo
echo "=========================================================="
echo " RESULT"
echo "=========================================================="
echo "WEB AGENT       : $CANON · $WEB_STATE"
echo "RADIO STATE     : $RADIO_STATE_BEFORE -> $RADIO_STATE_AFTER"
echo "RADIO PID BEFORE: $RADIO_BEFORE"
echo "RADIO PID AFTER : $RADIO_AFTER"

if [ -n "$RADIO_BEFORE" ] && [ "$RADIO_BEFORE" = "$RADIO_AFTER" ]; then
  echo "✅ RADIO PID UNCHANGED"
else
  echo "⚠️ RADIO PID differs/unknown — inspect before doing anything else"
fi

echo
echo "=== INSTALLED VERSION ==="
grep -F "AGENT_VERSION_R803" /usr/local/lib/andrik-radio-web-agent-r803.mjs | head -1 || true
ls -lh /usr/local/sbin/andrik-radio-safe-cleanup-r1026

echo
echo "=== SAFE CLEANUP DRY RUN ==="
/usr/local/sbin/andrik-radio-safe-cleanup-r1026 --dry-run || true

echo
echo "✅ R1026 OFFLINE INSTALL COMPLETE"
echo "✅ no curl used"
echo "✅ andrik-radio.service was NOT restarted by this installer"
